ValidationRule.description: Performance score may not exceed the manager's score (VLOOKUP on the manager's Name), and scores must be within 0-5 on half-point steps.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Manager_Name_Ref__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Performance_Score__c)), Performance_Score__c > NULLVALUE(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Employee_Record__c.Fields.Performance_Score__c, $ObjectType.Employee_Record__c.Fields.Name, Manager_Name_Ref__c), Performance_Score__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Performance Score may not exceed the manager's score.
